results.name: 1: repeated same-version/document notifications preserve selection identity and dirty draft
2: another resource changes without warning or clearing the selected dirty draft
3: actual same-resource document change retains draft and CAS rejection; discard adopts latest baseline
4: a higher revision with identical document remains a real stale-CAS warning
5: descriptor and availability changes at the same revision retain draft and warn
6: removal retains the dirty draft until explicit discard, without resurrecting the resource
7: starting an edit while a list reply is pending does not lose that edit
8: a selection change invalidates an old pending list reply
9: an old list reply cannot overwrite the result of a single successful save
10: changes during a held save are coalesced into a post-save refresh
11: owner switch rejects old reads and old-owner events
12: an old-owner save completion cannot clear or overwrite a newer owned operation
13: a session event supersedes an older initial owner lookup
14: own import selects the imported resource; an old-owner import result is ignored
15: later replies win over older list snapshots; unmount removes subscriptions
16: repeated same-owner session events preserve a held save lock, draft and successful result
17: repeated same-owner session events preserve a held import lock and select its single result
18: an old initial owner lookup and repeated same-owner events cannot cancel a held save
19: an old initial owner lookup and same-owner events cannot cancel a held import
20: same-owner profile refreshes without an operation preserve a dirty draft and unchanged selection identity
21: logout still isolates a held save result and does not repopulate the signed-out view
22: same-owner events also preserve the import lock while its required list refresh is held
